name: [Part 1] Window fills and then slides
test:
import math
s = MovingAverage(3)
actual = [s.next(x) for x in [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]]
assert all(math.isclose(a, b) for a, b in zip(actual, [1, 2, 3, 5, 7]))

name: [Part 1] Negative values and repeated evictions
test:
s = MovingAverage(2)
assert [s.next(x) for x in [-4, 0, 8, -2, -2]] == [-4, -2, 4, 3, -2]

name: [Part 2] Increasing weights during warm-up and eviction
test:
import math
s = WeightedMovingAverage(3)
actual = [s.next(x) for x in [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]]
expected = [1, 7/3, 22/6, 34/6, 46/6]
assert all(math.isclose(a, b) for a, b in zip(actual, expected))

name: [Part 2] Weights follow position, not numeric value
test:
import math
s = WeightedMovingAverage(2)
actual = [s.next(x) for x in [10, -2, 4, 0]]
assert all(math.isclose(a, b) for a, b in zip(actual, [10, 2, 2, 4/3]))

name: [Both parts] Size one and independent instances
test:
for cls in [MovingAverage, WeightedMovingAverage]:
    s = cls(1)
    assert [s.next(x) for x in [4, -3, 0, 12]] == [4, -3, 0, 12]
    a, b = cls(2), cls(2)
    assert a.next(8) == 8
    assert b.next(-5) == -5
    assert a.next(8) == 8
    assert b.next(-5) == -5
